title: I’m turning GTA V NPCs into socially aware AI citizens
author: Hutch_230
selftext:
Los Santos Alive is a mod for Grand Theft Auto V (Legacy & Enhanced) that integrates generative AI into NPC interaction.

This simply would not be possible without LLMs, and I think its a good example in the context of a very well developed world of how AI can create very immersive interaction.

NPCs can be spoken to through either text or realtime microphone input, and are contextually aware of:

* their role in the world (bartender, gang member, beachgoer, etc.)
* the current weather and time
* the street and district they are in
* whether they are indoors or outdoors
* nearby locations and surrounding context

When an interaction becomes meaningful, the NPC is marked as “relevant” by the system. Over time, the world begins building an inferred understanding of who that NPC is — including routines, habits, and lifestyle patterns.

A bartender you regularly speak to may later be encountered returning to work the following evening. A civilian you met outside a bar may later be found nearby unwinding after their shift.

Crimes committed by the player are also remembered within the world.

NPC reactions depend on:

* severity of the crime
* distance from the event
* time passed
* personal relevance

For example:

* bartenders may discuss the murder of another bartender nearby
* civilians near a shooting may reference it in ambient conversation
* major crimes can spread across Los Santos as rumors or news

The goal of the project is not just AI conversations, but making Los Santos feel socially reactive and alive.

Anyone that's interested in demos & updates for the mod, let me know in the comments and I can link you the discord, I'll be giving free access to the first 100 or so people that join
